hero.description: SnipDock lets you collect text, images and links from different tabs, clean the content and prepare everything for Word, Google Docs or Notion.

steps.title: Research without the copy-paste chaos.
steps.description: Move from scattered tabs to organized, ready-to-use content in three simple steps.
steps.collectText: Save text, images and links from any tab using SnipDock's browser tools.
steps.cleanText: Remove duplicated or unnecessary web clutter and keep the useful content.
steps.exportText: Copy your research cleanly into Word, Google Docs, Notion and other tools.

features.title: One place for the material you find across the web.
features.description: SnipDock is designed for students, writers, researchers and anyone who regularly gathers information online.
features.textText: Save selected text from different tabs without interrupting your research.
features.imagesText: Store useful visual references together with the rest of your collected material.
features.linksText: Keep links and source references attached to your research.
features.multitabText: Gather information from multiple pages into the same temporary workspace.
features.cleanText: Reduce duplicated content, unwanted formatting and common web clutter.
features.copyText: Prepare texts, images and sources together for pasting into your preferred workspace.
